_readme: Banners that have been announced but don't have wiki pages yet. wiki_to_schedule.py merges these in on every run and drops each one automatically as soon as the wiki has a banner for the same resonator or weapon in the same version, so nothing here needs cleaning up by hand. Leave element, weaponType and rarity out for reruns: they are copied from the item's earlier banners. Date-only values show as approximate in the app.
